gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Sleek, tile-like and unmistakably futuristic, Audiowide sets its tall lowercase in uniform strokes, while Noto Sans Nabataean stands nearly cap-tall beneath it. Their shared height keeps the page tidy.
gen-fs-erode-archivo: Archivo reads like an editorial voice with a commanding x-height and curves that open outward instead of curling in. Archivo handles the steady talking; Erode, crisp and lightly modulated, is the one to admire up close.
gen-fs-erode-fs-epilogue: Erode carries a crisp, graceful serif with modest contrast you only notice on a close look. And Epilogue answers in curvy, wire-like monoline strokes, which is the real charm of the pairing.
gen-fs-erode-fs-fira-sans: Erode brings a serif with calm variation in weight from stem to serif, crisp and graceful in its details. And Fira Sans is the sturdier half, bending its strokes like cable with no swelling at all.
gen-fs-erode-fs-merriweather-sans: Crisp is the first word for Erode, whose horizontals run lighter but never threadlike. But shrink that heading or enlarge Merriweather Sans too far and its sturdy tall lowercase starts to crowd the serif's finer touches.
gen-fs-erode-manrope: Erode is a graceful serif with gently modulated strokes and a prominent x-height that stays crisp. Manrope is its opposite in the best way, with dowel-straight stems and bright open curves at every turn.
gen-fs-erode-satoshi: Satoshi reads soaring and friendly, its wide-open e never squeezed and every stroke cut to a single width. Erode earns its keep big and short, where its light modulation shows.
gen-fs-excon-gf-fauna-one: Excon crowds its towering lowercase together like chalk marks on a full slate, every stroke carrying the same visual weight. Fauna One steps in with a dignified serif, a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders.
gen-fs-excon-gf-glegoo: Excon packs towering, efficient letters tightly together, each stroke drawn at one thickness with open terminals. But Glegoo, a refined serif with big counters and unclosed curves, gives that tight energy somewhere to breathe.
